# Mediabunny

Unmodified browser bundle from Mediabunny 1.61.0, licensed under MPL-2.0 (see LICENSE).

- Source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.61.0
- Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mediabunny@1.61.0/dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs

Used to losslessly remux recorded video into a finalized, indexed MP4 or WebM file. The application loads it only when finishing an export; the service worker caches it for offline exports.
